name: sigformel-web.public.dappnode.eth
description: Standalone Sigformel glyph catalogue and full stateless name workshop, with private Dappnode Open UI and separate public-host support. Browser-local shortlist/preferences; no shared server records, ship or host ports.
gettingStarted: Open UI uses http://web.sigformel-web.public.dappnode.private:8088 on your Dappnode private network. The separate public website is https://sigformel.quantumtekh.com via the existing connector preserving Host sigformel.quantumtekh.com. Private access does not require the public route. Both modes support same-origin stateless compose; browser preferences and shortlist are separate per origin and are not transferred or synchronized. No account, setup secret, shared records or volume. Independent of the native moon app. First-party MIT and separate third-party notices apply. Version 0.1.1 corrects 0.1.0 public-only Open UI/ingress; live upgrade and route checks are separate operator steps.
